People Ops: Quick note 18-hr attestation window opening. We need everyone on the access roster to do a short attestation and confirm/upload any outstanding SOC2/ISO artifacts. Deadline: Tuesday 11:59pm PT. :hourglass:

People Ops: Quick checklist:
1) Complete the 5-min attestation: https://internal.redwood/attest-quick
2) Upload evidence or add a one-line placeholder per control: https://internal.redwood/forms/evidence-lite
3) Managers: run the verification step after your team uploads
Office hours: Mon 09:00-11:00 PT in #help for fast triage.

Greg (Infra): Do infra-only service accounts need to attest? They have deploy keys but no customer PII.

People Ops: Yes. Any identity with deploy or prod keys must attest and indicate whether it touches customer-data flows. If purely infra and no data, mark "infra-only" in the form.

Ivy L.: Can I upload a short compliance note instead of a full export? Some of our exports are multi-GB.

People Ops: Short note ok as interim: include expected export ETA and ticket link. Use filename pattern for final uploads: redwood_evidence_<team>_<YYYYMMDD>_v1.zip. If you can add S3 metadata, set header x-redwood-retain-days with the retention value.

Legal Sam: Managers: we'll be sampling items post-window. If an item is genuinely delayed, mark it BLOCKED with owner + ETA; Legal will need that to include in the exception log.

contractor-maya: Attested and added placeholder for CC-Auth-3 (ticket #9821). Thanks for the office hours earlier.

AuditBot: Reminder scheduled 12 hours left. Pending items will be surfaced in the weekly compliance digest.

Greg (Infra): One more 1) can we use a console screenshot as proof? 2) where do we put the ETA?

People Ops: 1) screenshot + job id is fine as "placeholder" 2) put ETA and ticket link in the form notes field; prefix subject with CONTROL-<id> for auto-matching.

People Ops: Final: we'll publish a short risk heatmap for execs after the window closes and do a quick follow-up with any high-risk BLOCKED items. Ping this thread or drop into office hours if you need help. :white_check_mark:
